column1: # scripts/stacks.tsv: one row per stack. Read through scripts/stacks.js, its one reader, by scripts/on-manifest-change.js (restore after a merge), scripts/format-changed.js (pre-push format check) and the project-init skill (scaffold). Commands run through the OS shell.

# Columns, tab-separated: stack | triggers: file patterns, space-separated, matched by path or basename | needs: a file that must exist at the root for the row to fire, or - | restore: command run from the repo root, or - | scaffold: commands joined by " && " with {Name} PascalCase, {name} kebab-case, {template} chosen by project-init, or - | formats: patterns of the staged files this row formats, or - | format: check-only command, {files} replaced by those staged paths, or - to skip. Fallbacks separated by " ?? " are tried in order until one tool is installed (the dotnet row prefers a project Husky.NET task runner, then dotnet format). It must not rewrite files; the hook reports and blocks, and git commit --no-verify skips it. The dotnet row loads the project first, so it costs 5-15s on a commit touching C#: blank the cell to opt out.

column5: npm init -y && npm install --save-dev typescript vitest @types/node prettier && npx tsc --init --rootDir src --outDir dist
pnpm init && pnpm add -D typescript vitest @types/node prettier && npx tsc --init --rootDir src --outDir dist
yarn init -y && yarn add -D typescript vitest @types/node prettier && npx tsc --init --rootDir src --outDir dist

dotnet new sln -n {Name} && dotnet new {template} -o src/{Name} && dotnet new xunit -o tests/{Name}.Tests && dotnet add tests/{Name}.Tests reference src/{Name} && dotnet sln {Name}.sln add src/{Name} tests/{Name}.Tests && dotnet new tool-manifest && dotnet tool install husky && dotnet husky install && git config core.hooksPath .githooks
column7: dotnet husky run --group pre-push ?? dotnet format --no-restore --verify-no-changes --include {files}
